annotations.title: An allocation ETF or a built portfolio against an ETFIQ benchmark

description: Sets an allocation ETF, or a portfolio build_portfolio builds, beside an ETFIQ benchmark. With ticker (such as AOR): how the fund did against the benchmark for its band (set by its look-through stock share), over the same dates, as ETFIQ published it: total returns by window and the difference, risk and cost. With portfolio (the arguments build_portfolio took, its answer's compare.arguments.portfolio): the same portfolio built again beside the ETFIQ strategic benchmark nearest its looked-through stock share, the benchmark's own 1Y, 3Y, 5Y, 10Y and since-inception windows exactly as published, each with its dates and basis (hypothetical before the freeze date), and the differences in stock share and weighted fee in percentage points; and, in portfolio_returns, the portfolio's hypothetical returns beside the benchmark's over the same months, window by window, with each difference in percentage points. Refuses, and estimates nothing, when ETFIQ has not published what is asked.

portfolio.description: The arguments build_portfolio took: its answer's compare.arguments.portfolio.
